messages:
Nina (CSM): Kicking off Northpoint 14-day pilot. Scope: semantic embeddings for KB + lightweight chat for support triage.
Rohit (Solutions): Quick clarifying Qs: expected doc count? sensitive PII considerations? success metrics?
Eve (Northpoint PM): We'll provide 12k docs (S3 bundle) and an eval set of 25 queries. No PII in the sandbox. Success = 3 support agents using assistant, median relevance >= 0.72, p95 latency < 550ms.
Samir (Northpoint Infra): Security reqs: data residency EU-only, audit logs to our Splunk, and SAML SSO for admin. We need a private VPC peering option. ETA for network config: day 3.
Nina (CSM): Proposed timeline: Day0-1 creds & discovery; Day2-4 networking & peering; Day5 ingest & index; Day6-9 tuning + spot-checks; Day10 exec demo; Day11-14 iterate & go/no-go. Agree?
Rohit (Solutions): Sounds good. I'll prepare ingest CLI + mapping (JSONL: id,text,metadata) and a small index script.
Jules (Enablement): I'll run a 45-min rep training on Day6 and a 30-min admin ops walkthrough on Day3. Please confirm attendees.
Eve (Northpoint PM): Attendees: agents Lena, Omar, Pri; infra: Samir + security lead Clare. Procurement also needs a ballpark cost for the pilot.
Finance Bot: Rough pilot cost posted in doc (Dedicated-small estimate + token projection).
Nina (CSM): Action items (owner, due): 1) Network CIDR + Splunk webhook (Samir) - day1. 2) Ingest sample + CLI (Rohit) - day2. 3) Training invites (Jules) - day2. 4) Eval set + expected answers (Eve) - day2. 5) Cost calc (Finance) - day3.
Samir (Northpoint Infra): CIDR and Splunk endpoint posted in the board. Also asking for TLS cipher list and cert exchange instructions.
Rohit (Solutions): Will wire audit logs to Splunk and include session IDs. Quick ingest example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" --data-binary @docs.jsonl```
Eve (Northpoint PM): One more: can we run a short A/B during Day8 (50/50 hosted vs dedicated) to compare latency/recall?
Nina (CSM): Yes, we can canary 50/50 and capture metrics. Risk flags: renewal risk if agents don't adopt or if relevance < 0.6 after tuning. We'll schedule a Day8 mid-pilot review and Day10 exec demo.
Onboarding Bot: Onboarding board created: https://redwood.company/onboard/northpoint-pilot (permissions: team-only).
Nina (CSM): Thanks everyone 389. I'll update the board with action owners and follow up for finance. Ping here for blockers.
